description: Every transfer function available for morph-position assignment. Browse by family, listen, pick M0 and M100. Feeds directly into recipe_pipeline.py.

vocal-formant.description: Fixed vowel formant tables (F1-F3), asymmetric Q-axes, tight morph corridors. Human voice and talkbox character filters.

acid-resonant.description: TB-303 style resonant lowpass + bass processor filters. High-radius pole clusters (0.98+), 24 dB/octave cascading, aggressive frequency sweeps.

notch-zplane.description: Complex zero trajectories dragging across the spectrum. Phaser, dual-morph, and z-plane lattice filters with moving notches.

eq-shaper.description: Static or dynamically swept multi-band bell filters with flat Q attitudes. Graphic and parametric EQ curve emulations.

cab-comb.description: Narrow, closely-spaced resonant peaks mimicking physical acoustic spaces. Speaker cabinet and room comb-filter responses.

pipeline_usage.cli_example: python tools/recipe_pipeline.py my_body vocal/ee vocal/ah --family auto --q-attitude spare-the-air:5:0.04
workflow: 2. Click a source to see its transfer function (frequencies + bandwidths)
3. Listen to the audition render (if available)
4. Pick M0 source and M100 source
5. Run recipe_pipeline.py with the two intent specs
6. The pipeline measures → fits poles → assigns lanes → authors zeros → applies Q → certifies → compiles
7. Drag the .body240 into TRENCH and use your ears
